verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Trigger.dev ships its own MCP *server* (docs-18, docs-29, docs-12) so AI assistants can call Trigger.dev's tools — this is the opposite direction from the story, which asks whether Trigger.dev's own tasks/agents (e.g. the chat.agent AI framework) can consume external MCP servers as tool providers. No evidence describes Trigger.dev agents connecting to or configuring third-party MCP servers for tool access.
